environment: Affected Windows x64 HP computer, existing per-user Aura installation
finding: OMEN classified Aura as a game and automatically boosted it, including WebView2, Edge and WhatsApp in its optimized process list.

fix.scope: Current user's OMEN package settings; automatic boosting for all games
fix.method: OMEN BoostService.SetBoostAllRegistryKeyValue(false) in its packaged application context, with readback

limits: Other computers and OMEN versions were not tested.
Enabling Boost All again can reintroduce the conflict while Aura remains in OMEN's game list.
